list.title: Decreasing Debt:
list.snippet: Tesla's debt-to-equity ratio has generally decreased over the past few years, indicating a reduction in its reliance on debt financing.

list.title: Industry Comparison:
list.snippet: Compared to other companies in the automotive industry, Tesla's debt-to-equity ratio is relatively low, suggesting a more conservative approach to borrowing.

list.title: Financial Health:
list.snippet: A lower debt-to-equity ratio generally indicates a stronger financial position, as it means the company has less debt relative to its equity.

list.title: Recent Trends:
list.snippet: While there has been a recent increase in total debt, the debt-to-equity ratio remains relatively low, indicating a continued focus on managing debt levels.
